name: ElastiFlow
what_it_is: Network flow data collection and visualization platform built on the Elastic Stack (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana) that ingests NetFlow, sFlow, and IPFIX telemetry. The legacy open-source version is deprecated; users are directed to the commercial ElastiFlow Unified Flow Collector.
configuration: Logstash pipeline configuration files for each protocol
Elasticsearch index templates and ILM policies
Kibana saved objects (dashboards, visualizations, index patterns)
modes: Legacy open-source mode (Elastic Stack 6.x/7.x, Logstash-based, deprecated)
Current commercial mode (ElastiFlow Unified Flow Collector, 10x+ throughput)
constraints: Local SSD storage is mandatory — HDD storage severely hampers performance
Monitor resolution optimized for 1920x1080 for Kibana dashboards
Legacy version is no longer maintained and targets older Elastic Stack versions
No built-in fault injection or traffic simulation capabilities
notable_absences: No docker-compose.yml found in the repository (404 on both main and master branches)
No fault injection or synthetic traffic generation tooling
No authentication or TLS configuration examples in the open-source repo
No active maintenance — project is deprecated in favor of commercial successor
